abstract: A submandibular endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor (EST-YST) is reported. The patient was a 1.5-year-old girl exhibiting a rapidly growing tumor in the submandibular region. The lesion showed the typical microscopic features including Schiller-Duval bodies and colloid bodies. Alpha-fetoprotein immunoreactivity was expressed by most tumor cells. There was no clinical or radiological evidence of the presence of this tumor elsewhere in the body.
abstract_ja: 1歳半の女児で、急速に増大する顎下部の内胚葉洞（卵黄嚢）腫瘍（EST-YST）を報告する。腫瘍の顕微鏡所見は典型的で、Schiller-Duval体およびコロイド体を含んでいた。腫瘍細胞の大半がαフェトプロテイン(AFP)に免疫反応性を示した。臨床的および画像的に、他の部位にこの腫瘍が存在する所見は認められなかった。
